product.name: Indio by Monoprice AC-2 True Bypass Vintage Analog Chorus Guitar Effect Pedal
product.description: Indio™ by Monoprice™              AC‑2 True Bypass Analog Chorus              Guitar Effect Pedal                  Created in the mid 70s in an effort to reproduce the modulated "jazz" amp sound of the time, the chorus effect pedal made a substantial contribution to popular music as one of the distinct guitar sounds of the decade. By replicating and recombining a shifted version of the guitar signal with its original, vintage analog chorus pedals create the lush and spacious vibrato sounds sought after by guitarists since their inception. The Indio™ AC‑2 True Bypass Analog Chorus Guitar Effect Pedal reproduces the original analog vibrato sounds that has given the chorus pedal its legendary status.                                    True bypass design          Modern reproduction of vintage analog chorus          Full‑size pedal with all metal construction                                      Powered by 9V battery or external power adapter          High‑impact, high‑quality switches          Fully analog                                                                                                                      TRIBUTE TO VINTAGE CHORUSES FROM THE 70s                                                          Using the same 2‑knob layout, the Indio™ AC‑2 True Bypass Analog Chorus Guitar Effect Pedal is a tribute to the originals. The AC‑2 is faithful in its reproduction of the original sound, while using modern versions of the same components used by the legendary pedals of the past. But the Indio AC‑2 isn't a simple copy. It combines equivalent components and layout with modern features, such as a true bypass design, robust switches, and all metal construction.                                                                                                                                            TRUE BYPASS DESIGN AND FULL METAL CONSTRUCTION                                                          Unlike most inexpensive guitar pedals, Indio™ pedals feature a true bypass design, keeping your tone pristine when not engaged. Other boutique guitar pedals featuring a true bypass design will cost several times more, while using the same components inside every Indio pedal.                                      Additionally, Indio true bypass guitar effects feature full metal construction, ensuring that they can withstand the rigors of the road. The full‑size housing provides enough separation on your board, reducing the crowding issues associated with inexpensive mini pedals.                                                                                                                                            VERSATILE POWER                                                          Indio™ true bypass guitar effect pedals can be powered either by a 9V battery or an external power supply, making them both versatile and venue/scenario‑proof. Use the 611690 Stage Right™ 9V Power Supply for Guitar Pedals (available separately) when playing at home, in your practice space, or when power is easily accessible at the venue. Alternatively, you can use a 9V battery to be free from extra cables or when power outlets aren't accessible.
